extracted.stage: Pre-grant; inheritance tax due before grant can issue, grant expected within 14 weeks
extracted.summary: A solicitor acting for executors of a £1,238,000 Winchester estate enquires about a £31,000 probate loan to pay inheritance tax before the grant issues.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry regarding funding for the executors of the Winchester estate. We have noted the estate value of £1,238,000 and the £31,000 sought to meet the inheritance tax liability prior to the grant. To take this further we would need the names and contact details of the executors, a breakdown of the estate assets and liabilities (including title details for the property), a copy of the will, the IHT account or computation and the date by which the tax falls due, and confirmation of your firm's engagement. Please also tell us whether any other borrowing or charges affect the estate. Once we have those documents a member of the team will review the enquiry and come back to you.
